title: +TALK, MOVE, THRIVE: COMMUNICATION FOR ACTIVE LIVING
description: Develops practical experience helping individuals change their behavior within a healthcare, coaching, or wellbeing setting. Applies conversational, listening, and motivational interviewing skills towards patients/clients to determine various ways to enhance knowledge and adherence within areas of physical activity and health promotion. Explores planning, promotion, and implementation strategies through a patient-centered communication approach.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
